seoTitle: RSS or Atom Feed to Sitemap Converter
metaDescription: Convert an RSS 2.0 or Atom feed into an XML sitemap: item links become loc, dates become lastmod. Free, private.
intro: Reads an RSS or Atom feed and writes a sitemap from its links and dates.
why:
Blogs and news sites already publish a feed. A sitemap from it can be a quick start or a supplement.

A feed lists only recent items, so this is not a full sitemap of the site. Dates are converted to W3C format in UTC. Items without an absolute link are skipped and counted.
howTo: Choose whether lastmod should include the time.
Copy the sitemap or merge it into yours.

faq.a: Both. RSS 2.0 item/link/pubDate and Atom entry/link/updated.
No. Paste it; a web page cannot fetch other sites.
